publication_surface.identifier: Official Journal references of harmonised standards supporting Directive 2006/42/EC
publication_surface.authenticity_basis: Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7(2)-(3) makes OJ publication of harmonised-standard references legally operative for presumption of conformity.

dependencies.condition_statement: Presumption of conformity under Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7(2) depends on conformity with harmonised standards whose references are published in the Official Journal, subject to any published restriction.

scope.statement: For shredder and chipper machines whose shredding means can rotate above 300 r·min−1, EN 50434:2014 does not confer presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC Annex I points 1.1.2(a) and 1.3.3 in the scope stated by Decision (EU) 2026/80.

source_refs.locator: Recitals 8-11 and Annex row 622a; OJ L 13.1.2026

forbidden_inferences: The restriction removes EN 50434:2014 from the Official Journal entirely.
The restriction removes presumption of conformity for machinery outside the stated high-speed shredder/chipper scope.
The restriction is a textual mutation of Directive 2006/42/EC Article 7.
Loss of presumption for the restricted requirements means conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC is impossible by another route.
notes: Issue #411 frozen product-capability workload case: maintained OJ citation with a scoped formal-objection restriction.
